propositions: A hard clarity floor must retain only rules with zero legitimate counterexamples in closed tickets carrying both plan-review and completion-verifier attestations.

Nonempty parsed Acceptance Criteria checkbox items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections are the only two hard floor rules; duplicate AC text and rebar citation edge checking are advisory or belong to other validation paths.

The unresolved sentinel rule must be narrowed to structural assignment forms (starts bullet/line, follows colon/equals/is, with removal assertions suppressed) to avoid false positives from removal assertions like 'NO stale TODO'.

File-impact path/reason validation belongs to write-schema integrity, not clarity scoring; rebar direct-edge checking applies only to absence-credit grounding, not ordinary provenance or downstream references.

Historical counterexamples must force rule narrowing or removal: 8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88 (duplicate global gate), c244-ba53-6280-4702 (removal assertion control), and 6673/94f9 (downstream provenance) must all pass the final ruleset.
